local:label-communities-schema-gap.title:
`label_communities` (llm.py) has no JSON-schema constant, unlike
`_EXTRACTION_JSON_SCHEMA`. Extraction is fixed; LABELLING is still broken —
probed on 0.9.25, 42/42 batches failed. Community names come from the free
deterministic `label_communities_by_hub` instead. Re-probe on each bump.

STILL PRESENT on 0.9.26 (re-probed 2026-07-26). The cheap re-probe is a file
diff, not a batch run: `llm.py` is BYTE-IDENTICAL across the two installs, so
the gap cannot have moved. Counts agree in both — `_EXTRACTION_JSON_SCHEMA` x2,
label-side schema constant x0, `def label_communities` x1 — and a bogus symbol
greps to 0 in the same file, so the zero is an absence rather than a broken
probe. Do the diff first on the next bump; only run the 42-batch probe if the
file actually changed.
